ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: (ISCHANGED(IMGS_Status__c) && ISPICKVAL(IMGS_Status__c, "Cancelled") && NOT(ISPICKVAL(Status, "Non Conversion"))) || (ISCHANGED(Status) && $Profile.Id = "00eV0000000Lx3T" && ISPICKVAL(Status, "Non Conversion") && NOT(ISPICKVAL(IMGS_Status__c, "Cancelled"))) || ((ISCHANGED(IMGS_Status__c) || ISCHANGED(OwnerId) || ISCHANGED(Status)) && ISPICKVAL(PRIORVALUE(IMGS_Status__c), "Cancelled") && $Profile.Id = "00eV0000000Lx3T")
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Please update the Case Status to Non Conversion when updating the IMGS Status to Cancelled. Note: This will also update and close out the opportunity to Lost. Once Cancelled, you will not be able to update the IMGS Status.
